Sin IA disponible hoy: selección automática por relevancia (créditos, categoría y radar). Configura ANTHROPIC_API_KEY o el vLLM local para el resumen redactado.

  1. Who’ll be next on Connie and Trevor’s list? Shots
    Connie & Trevor turn Mafia bosses to set the record straight in Argos’ bold new campaign.
    Agency: T&Pm/London; CD: Matthew Moreland, Chris Clarke; Prod Co: Merman; Director: Declan Lowney; Post/VFX: Electric Theatre Collective, Jason Wallis

  2. Common uses his common sense for BMW Shots
    A new campaign from Goodby Silverstein & Partners, directed by Henry Hobson at MJZ, hands the megaphone to common sense.
    Agency: Goodby Silverstein and Partners/San Francisco, BMW Certified; CD: Matthew Edwards, Clemens Zlami; Prod Co: MJZ/London; Director: Henry Hobson; Post/VFX: Pariah VFX & Post

  3. Chorus finds a quicker clicker Shots
    In a delightfully surreal campaign from McCann New Zealand, Carl Sundemo directs an everyday Kiwi dance his way through the net on an oversized mouse.
    Agency: McCann Group/Auckland, McCann New Zealand; CD: Gary Steele; Prod Co: Scoundrel; Director: Carl Sundemo; Post/VFX: Matic Prusnik

  4. Modern Post updates senior team Shots
    Modern Post welcomes Veronica Ware as Head of Creative Operations and promotes Kelly Zdanowicz to Head of Production.
    Post/VFX: Modern Post

  5. Fam Films Co-Founder on the Return to Story-First Advertising LBB
    Aadil Dhalech talks about creating his own production company with Mpho Twala, parenthood and his proudest work, as part of LBB’s The Directors series
    Prod Co: Fam Films

  6. Co-op Takes On the ‘Big Shop Faff’ LBB
    VCCP champions Aldi Price Match, showing customers they can get great value on everyday essentials without the hassle of a big shop
    Brand: Co-op; Agency: VCCP; Prod Co: Girl&Bear Studios; Director: Jonas Odell
